latter_ping.description: No-op discovery marker action announcing Latter Protocol v3 compatibility and hardware manifest

latter_push_v3.description: Push a revision-guarded Protocol v3 domain payload directly to the bound Device over the ESPHome Native API

latter_set_beacon_uuid.description: Provision the System's random 128-bit BLE iBeacon UUID into NVS and restart advertising if active

latter_factory_reset.description: Reset to defaults: erases every saved setting (the whole NVS partition, including the Wi-Fi driver's cached network data and RF calibration) and reboots. Compiled-in Wi-Fi credentials and the API key are kept, so the device rejoins Home Assistant unchanged

ui_input.description: Remote navigation input: action home|back|select|next|prev|left|right|up|down|cw|ccw (ok/click alias select); delta overrides the step for next/prev-style actions (0 = derive from action)

set_browse_slots.description: Push paginated media/speaker/search browse slots to the device

set_area_slots.description: Push paginated Area/Site entity control slots to the device

show_notification.description: Wake display, show an on-screen alert banner (priority normal|warning|critical, duration 3-60 s, default 10), optionally play the embedded WAV chime and show a camera snapshot; alert_id > 0 deduplicates repeats

latter_device_command.description: Execute a typed Device lifecycle, diagnostic, or UI command (restart|find_my|activate_screensaver|trigger_va|log_memory_report)

device_hello.description: Device-initiated handshake sent when Home Assistant connects to the ESPHome API, carrying optional NVS preference sync state

set_device_prefs.description: Persist on-device settings edits back to the Device's Latter subentry and increment prefs_seq

timer_alarm_state.description: Report on-device countdown timer and alarm ringing state transitions to Home Assistant

music_browse.description: Browse speakers, favorites, playlists, artists, albums, tracks, radio, or search

set_active_speaker.description: Select the active media_player target for a Latter device

media_command.description: Execute transport, seek, queue, speaker grouping, or play_media command on the active speaker

media_volume.description: Adjust or set volume on the active speaker or volume override target

area_browse.description: Browse Areas, Area domains, or paginated controllable entities

area_action.description: Execute an explicit domain action on an Area or specific entity

set_active_area.description: Set the active Area context for a Latter device (an on-device Area pick). Whether media follows is the Device's Latter setting

remote_action.description: Send a TV/AV remote command or select active remote slot

calendar_fetch.description: Refresh upcoming calendar agenda events for a Latter device

calendar_create_event.description: Create a new event on the primary configured calendar

intercom_broadcast.description: Broadcast a voice announcement to chosen speakers, the speakers in occupied Areas (target_device: occupied_areas), or every speaker

doorbell_intercom.description: Doorbell talkback and requests. action: talk_message (push-to-talk speech transcribed on the device, spoken at the door by Home Assistant), quick_reply, listen_start|listen_stop (door audio played on the device), call_target (rings other displays with a notification; no display-to-display audio), unlock_door (unlock request to Home Assistant), set_noise_reduction. noise_reduction: strong|light|off, the noise filter preset Home Assistant applies to door audio (FFmpeg). No echo cancellation; camera is auto-refreshing snapshots

save_custom_color.description: Save a custom RGB accent color from the on-device color wheel

set_dock_apps.description: Save the Home dock apps chosen on the device (Home settings) as the Device's Latter dock setting
